rounds.title: Shell panel controls
rounds.note: The panel's controls are their own parts now: components/shell-collapse (collapse), components/shell-project-switch (closed, open) and components/shell-project-option (option, selected), each drawn at rest, hovered, pressed and focused. elements/shell-main keeps only its layout states open, hidden and project-picker and declares the three controls with part:. The picker stays the switch's surface. 'Projekt öffnen…' is the SDK button and takes its states from components/button. a) today: rest look only. b) SDK transparent buttons for collapse and switch. c) Studio hairline buttons with their own hover, pressed and teal focus ring. Pick: c, because it keeps the switch's full-width layout and the teal focus ring every other Studio control draws. Sketch check: the CONTRAST findings on the shell's 1px panel and separator hairlines are false per Q175 (plans/ethlete-studio/design-to-code.md): only borders that identify a control need 3:1; a tool fix is with the CLI stream.

a.note: Today: plain buttons with a rest look only, no declared controls.

b.note: SDK transparent buttons for collapse and project switch: SDK hover, press, the SDK focus ring and a 120 ms fade. Costs: the hairline ring and raised fill go, the switch reads as plain text at rest, and the chevron sits after the name, not at the right edge (the SDK label does not stretch).

c.note: Studio's own buttons keep the hairline ring and raised fill; hover and open lift to the overlay fill, press to the pressed fill, focus draws the Studio teal ring that tree rows and disclosures use, all on --transition-state. Costs: about 25 lines of interaction CSS next to the SDK button's own.
